_howToUse: The Hours page, top to bottom. Each section is one card: title, an optional note, and rows of label + value. Add, remove or reorder sections freely — the app draws whatever is here. A section with "source": "vendor-exhibit" fills its own rows from the exhibit events on the schedule, so the hall's hours cannot drift from the cards attendees already see.
